_comment: METHOD POLICY for the soccer study -- the decisions a human made about
how charting works, as opposed to what the corpus is (study.json).
RECONSTRUCTED, and the distinction matters. This study was charted before
the policy file existed, so these are the values the pipeline was actually
built to use, recovered from the code and from the sessions that set them.
Where the honest provenance is 'a default nobody discussed', it says so --
those are marked implicit, and they are the entries most worth revisiting.
Filled against templates/policy.json. Every value here is a fork in OUR
pipeline, which is why each carries what a decision record carries: what
was chosen, why, and whether it was chosen or defaulted into.
filled_by: the study owner, with the agent proposing defaults
source: INTAKE.md sections G-K; reconstructed from the built pipeline

decisions._prose_role_provenance: decided. 'our garden works are based on the code layer; the prose is only used for surfacing the silent choices.' Confirmed by measurement afterwards: prose spans reproduce at ARI 0.480 against code at 0.895 core.
decisions._span_provenance: implicit. The extraction prompt permits gaps and does not permit interleaving; nobody argued for either. Worth revisiting -- allowing interleaving would make span matching much harder to falsify.
decisions._same_run_provenance: decided, after V6 measured it. 76 of 96 same-run merge groups spanned more than five lines and were over-merges on reading. Enforced by repair_option_splits.py --span and audited as V6, which now shows 2 survivors.
decisions._similarity_provenance: decided, and it is the single largest lever in the method. 'for distillation, we should compare semantically, not verbatimly. the boundaries can move slightly without affecting downstream work.' Measured: verbatim 0.176, lenient 0.713, core 0.895 on one extraction. The agent had led with verbatim and was corrected.

options._singleton_provenance: decided. Novel options are the rare-variant analogue and are kept. 64% of options are singletons; excluding them moves by-option fork agreement from 0.31 to 0.69, which is a change in the question rather than an improvement in the answer.
options._similarity_provenance: implicit. 0.5 is the match_options default and was never argued. It governs every cross-build option comparison, so it deserves a sensitivity check it has not had.

forks._exclusivity_provenance: decided, with the violation accepted as a finding rather than repaired away. 86% of runs hold two options at one fork, dominated by the skin-tone exposure fork at 158 of 223. Setting this true does not make it true; it makes V2 an audited exhibit.
forks._pivotal_provenance: decided 2026-08-30, replacing the two-condition test (coverage >= 25% AND effective options > 1.5). eff_all counts 'did not reach' as a level, so ONE threshold carries both engagement and disagreement: low coverage lets absent dominate, agreement lets the modal option dominate. 17 forks qualify, containing all 11 the old test found; the 6 added are ones where everyone who acted agreed but a third never acted -- contested about WHETHER, not how. The old eff also over-counted, giving each decision record a vote rather than each analysis; see vocab.fork_stats.

stability._role_provenance: decided, and it is the load-bearing refusal in this file. 'stability is a signal for the human to review, not a target for you to hit.' Fork induction can be driven toward ARI 1.0 by merging almost nothing; core-first fork formation and the .osplit repair are both on file as cases where a principled change moved agreement for reasons unrelated to validity.

tuning._note: The human benchmark (reviews/human-benchmark) is the intended external criterion. It has run: at the options layer two raters agree at 0.818 and two builds at 0.849, and no tuning toward higher self-agreement is authorised.

stability._replicates_provenance: decided before the first build. 5 gives 4 df per parent; 2 per parent would have given 1, and an sd on that is compatible with almost anything.

audit._blocking_provenance: decided. No check blocks a build. Most carry no null and rank for human attention; treating them as gates would convert a weak signal into a hard decision.
audit._queue_provenance: implicit. V1 alone queues 561 pairs, which is not a queue. 60 is a guess at what a person will actually read and has never been checked against what a person did read.

_open: review_queue_max 60 is a guess about human attention, not a measurement.
interleaving_allowed false was never argued; it constrains what extraction can express.
outcomes.json reliability is unmeasured; 52 of 207 records have no provenance.
similarity.threshold 0.5 has never had a sensitivity check.

Effective options is defined once, in vocab.fork_stats (one vote per analysis at its modal option), and every reported figure reads it. The human-benchmark packet was generated before that sweep, so the effective-option counts printed on its sheets predate the definition.
